2026_02_PHI_TEN.headline: Philadelphia’s reshuffled interior draws a Jeffery Simmons test in Nashville
2026_02_PHI_TEN.paragraph1: Philadelphia reaches Tennessee with Landon Dickerson on injured reserve, putting its replacement interior line directly in the path of Jeffery Simmons. Jalen Carter and Cooper DeJean are available, but Jonathan Greenard remains out, so the Eagles must generate edge pressure without him. Tennessee needs Cam Ward to stay ahead of the rush and avoid long passing downs against Vic Fangio’s coverage structure; Philadelphia can lean on Jalen Hurts’ mobility and balance if its interior protection prevents Simmons from disrupting the pocket.
2026_02_PHI_TEN.model_rationale: Philadelphia’s interior protection against Simmons and Tennessee’s ability to keep Ward out of obvious passing situations should decide which offense can preserve its preferred structure.
